comments.body:
Merged via merge-train 2026-11-18 — thanks! Validation found two small follow-ups, neither blocking:

1. No test pins the new `agent_name` description: setting the 17 `.describe(PROJECT_AGENT_NAME_DESCRIPTION)` calls back to `ACT_AS_PARAM_DESCRIPTION` leaves the suite green (acceptance criterion 2 of #4616). One test walking `createProjectTools` and asserting no `agent_name` description equals `ACT_AS_PARAM_DESCRIPTION` would close it.
2. A non-admin user key passing `agent_name` still gets the backend's `act_as_not_permitted` message ("Only an admin's user key can act on behalf of an agent…") passed through by `fail()` in `tools/projects.ts`, which points the caller at an admin key that the project routes then refuse. Giving that code the same `explain()` treatment as `agent_key_required` would finish the wording fix.
